issues.detail: The Chinese adds '你若這樣做' ('if you do this'), which is not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew states the consequence directly: 'your corpse shall not come to the grave of your fathers' (לֹֽא תָב֥וֹא נִבְלָתְךָ֖ אֶל קֶ֥בֶר אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ), without a conditional clause. This addition changes the force of the statement from a direct declaration to a conditional warning.
